title: •Inconsequential Losses
caption: •Inconsequential Losses (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. You may forfeit non-lightsaber weapons (using forfeit value = 3); place your just forfeited weapon in Used Pile. During your deploy phase, if you just deployed a vehicle or starship, may ▼ a weapon (for free) on that vehicle or starship. {alter}
lore: With its superior numbers, the Empire knowingly sacrifices the safety of many units and weapons in order to preserve the greater war machine.

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; red circle-slash A → {alter}. Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px (Death Star II). Copyright line not legible on the 350 px scan; set-convention form. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px).
